title: AI-ML Based Intelligent Dead Reckoning System for Seamless Navigation
description: Continuously tracks a vehicle even when GPS/GNSS is unavailable, such as inside tunnels, underground roads, dense urban areas or forests.

pipeline_stages.name: Smartphone Sensor Data Ingestion
pipeline_stages.description: Takes raw continuous high-rate data from smartphone sensors.

pipeline_stages.name: Data Cleaning & Automatic Virtual Orientation Alignment
pipeline_stages.description: Cleans sensor noise and automatically understands phone orientation inside vehicle, so phone does not have to be kept in a fixed position.

pipeline_stages.name: AI Motion Pattern & Disturbance Characterization
pipeline_stages.description: Deep learning models (TensorFlow / PyTorch 1D-CNN + GRU) analyze sensor patterns in real time.

analyzed_patterns.name: Speed
analyzed_patterns.description: Forward velocity estimation from inertial signatures

analyzed_patterns.name: Bumps & Potholes
analyzed_patterns.description: Road surface roughness and transient shock detection

analyzed_patterns.name: Unwanted Phone Movement
analyzed_patterns.description: Distinguishes phone handling/drops from vehicle maneuvers

analyzed_patterns.name: Sensor Reliability
analyzed_patterns.description: Epistemic uncertainty and sensor trust metric estimation

pipeline_stages.name: EKF / UKF / IEKF Sensor-Fusion & Positioning
pipeline_stages.description: Sensor-fusion algorithm combining cleaned information, map matching, and vehicle motion constraints.
rules: When GNSS is available: Quietly helps maintain accurate positioning.
When GNSS disappears: Automatically switches to AI + IMU dead reckoning without user intervention.
Map Matching & Constraints: Non-Holonomic Constraints (NHC) ensure vehicle stays on realistic road and prevents physically impossible movements.

unique_features.name: Dynamic Process-Noise Adaptation
unique_features.summary: Instead of keeping uncertainty fixed, AI changes it according to driving situation.
unique_features.rule: Smooth road → lower uncertainty (Q ~ 0.35x); bumpy road or sharp turn → higher uncertainty (Q ~ 5.5x).

unique_features.name: Stop-Based Drift Correction
unique_features.summary: Standstill detection (ZUPT) combined with retrospective trajectory smoothing.
unique_features.rule: When vehicle stops, compares estimated journey with road map to correct previous A → B trajectory before continuing to C.

unique_features.name: AI Fallback Mechanism
unique_features.summary: Never blindly trusts AI. Safeguarded with physics failover.
unique_features.rule: If AI becomes uncertain (abnormal sensor data, sudden phone movement), temporarily falls back to traditional IEKF.

unique_features.name: Seamless GNSS Switching
unique_features.summary: Dual-mode operation with smooth innovation damping.
unique_features.rule: When GNSS returns, smoothly corrects accumulated error with exponential damping instead of suddenly jumping.

unique_features.name: Confidence-Aware Navigation
unique_features.rule: Provides 95% horizontal confidence error ellipses (± meters) and confidence tiers (HIGH, MODERATE, DEGRADED).

unique_features.name: Optional Camera Assistance
unique_features.summary: Visual odometry optical flow forward speed assist.
unique_features.rule: Camera provides additional visual movement estimate alongside IMU to bound longitudinal drift.
